# Generated by gen_p05.py - do not edit by hand.
source openssl asn1parse (OpenSSL 3.x): independently decodes tag class, constructed/primitive, depth and length from the same bytes
seed 1
compare records node=depth,cls,pc,tag,length,value
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 BOOLEAN, NULL, OCTET STRING and BIT STRING (with its unused-bits byte) decode correctly
requirement R2 INTEGER is two's complement: a value needing a leading 0x00 pad byte is still read correctly, and so is a negative value
requirement R3 OBJECT IDENTIFIER decodes its base-128 arcs to dotted notation, including arcs that need more than one byte
requirement R4 SEQUENCE, SET and context-specific tags ([0], [3], ...) are constructed and recurse, with the right depth for each child
requirement R5 Both length forms work: short form (fits in one byte) and long form (length needs 2 or more bytes)
requirement E2E A structure shaped like a real certificate fragment, mixing every node type in one walk
